## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 457 captures during May 2024. This represents the activity submitted for review during the month. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. No additional activity categories are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 26 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.7 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that proceeded to assessment. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 95 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 2 days. This measure describes the midpoint of the time taken for images to move from photography to grading. Staff raised no new equipment faults during May 2024. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide the monthly operational position for West Gate Eye Clinic.
